baseline_sha_policy: Original 24-file manifest remains immutable. Only the specifically recorded replacement blob is accepted by this draft's source-level tests.

api/support-stats.js.reason: Existing public aggregate reader returned HTTP 200 with zero on missing credentials/failure; fetchAllUrl discarded pagination completeness and could publish truncated results.
api/support-stats.js.scope: Return 503 or 502 unavailable on read failure/incomplete page, preserve successful aggregate schema and historical records; require all existing contributing sources to complete.
api/support-stats.js.release_gate: Owner approves exact diff and reconciles live counters against frozen historical data before merge.

api/support.js.reason: Legacy GET support writer treated all resolved HTTP database responses as stored events, even when status was 4xx/5xx. Preview traffic sharing storage credentials could also pollute historic counters.
api/support.js.scope: Only production GET requests can create an event; mark browser counted and r=1 only when service acknowledges success. Existing successful production record shape, direct link redirect destination and historic rows unchanged.
api/support.js.release_gate: Requires owner review of exact changed source, frozen-count reconciliation, historical direct-link compatibility and explicit production authorization.
